created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string representing when the file was created.
created_at.title: Created At

downloadable.description: Whether the file can be downloaded.
downloadable.title: Downloadable

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string representing when the file will expire and become unavailable for download. Null if the file does not expire. For files uploaded with `expires_in_seconds`, this is the upload time plus that value.
expires_at.title: Expires At

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded file.
filename.title: Filename

id.description:
Unique object identifier.

The format and length of IDs may change over time.
id.title: Id

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

type.description:
Object type.

For files, this is always `"file"`.
type.title: Type
